caribbean.headline: Heavy Rain and Strong Winds for St. Maarten Today
caribbean.paragraph: St. Maarten is experiencing southeasterly winds up to 29 kt with seas to 6.0 ft and an ENE swell period of 9 s, accompanied by 75% rain probability. I advise port operators and mariners to secure small craft and prepare for brief heavy downpours and reduced visibility, with Antigua a secondary concern where winds are near 19 kt.

mediterranean.headline: Mykonos Sees 25 kt Winds, 6.6 ft Seas
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing WNW swell-driven seas to 6.6 ft with winds up to 25 kt and a 7 s swell period, and less than 10% rain probability. I recommend caution for small craft given winds in the Small Craft Advisory range and the moderate 7 s WNW swell, while Barcelona remains light with 9 kt winds and minimal wave action.
